product_brief: A C90 library supporting the ML-DSA / FIPS 204 post-quantum cryptography standard with minimal performance and maintenance cost.
pqc_capability_description: v1.0.0-alpha release of a C90 library for ML-DSA / FIPS 204. Designed for production with minimal dependencies. Includes native backends for AArch64 and x86-64. Memory safety, type safety, and timing leakage are checked via static model checking (CBMC) and dynamic instrumentation (valgrind). External APIs are expected but not guaranteed to be stable.
architecture_type: Library with native backends for AArch64 and x86-64
fips_validated: Supports FIPS 204 standard; validation status not stated
regulatory_status: Supported by the Linux Foundation and Post-Quantum Cryptography Alliance
pqc_roadmap_details: Alpha release with external APIs expected but not guaranteed to be stable
implementation_attack_surface: Memory safety, type safety, and absence of various classes of timing leakage are automatically checked using static model checking (CBMC) and dynamic instrumentation (valgrind)
testing_&_validation_methods: Static model checking (CBMC) and dynamic instrumentation (valgrind)
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Minimal and configurable dependencies on the standard library
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Designed for production deployments with minimal performance and maintenance cost; easy to integrate into diverse environments
